full_text:
The Guardian of Yonaguni is the eighteenth issue of Huntik Magazine and the final comic book in the series to be released. The story takes place during the end of Season 2, some time after the defeat of the Betrayer but prior to Dante Vale joining the Huntik Foundation Council.

Synopsis

The Huntik team travel to Japan where they dive down to the underwater island of Yonaguni and battle Wilder and the Organization for the Amulet of Kyojin.

Trivia

• The cover art features Pendragon in his original form, however in the actual comic story, he appears in his Powerbonded form as the story takes place after the final battle with the Betrayer.

• This comic was the last piece of Huntik media to be published until the exhibition of the Artbook in 2019.

• This issue included an exclusive toy of the Willblade.

Image caption: The Willblade toy sword
